tools.name: search_patterns
tools.description: Search the vendored Pattern-Assist corpus (hybrid lexical + embeddings when available; lexical fallback). Returns ranked patterns with source_ref citations and optional when_not guidance. Use this before asserting an approach.

tools.name: recommend_patterns
tools.description: C-03: ranked Pattern-Assist recommendations for a task. Each hit carries a corpus why, a when-not / FTO trade-off, and cited same-area cross-links. Use this when the learner wants alternatives, not just a lexical hit list.

tools.name: get_pattern
tools.description: Lookup a single Pattern-Assist row by stable id. Returns 404-shaped payload when unknown — never fabricates a nearest match.

tools.name: list_patterns
tools.description: Paginated inventory of pattern ids and summaries from the vendored corpus.

tools.name: list_public_pages
tools.description: Site map for agents: canonical human pages plus read-only REST/MCP endpoints on this host.
